The '''Marzoon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Marzoon sector/Legends|Marzoon sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system shared its name with the [[Politics/Legends|government]] known as the [[Marzoon Confederation]].<ref name="DarkStryder">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Marzoon system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square I-16.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
